title: idp JOSE test vector
description: One verification case: a token, the keys and policy to verify it with, and the expected verdict. Every implementation must produce exactly this verdict. See docs/adr/0002-vectors-are-the-contract.md and docs/adr/0003-verifier-check-order.md.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Must equal the file name without the .json extension. Prefix with 'rfc' for RFC cases and 'neg-' for generated negative cases.

source.description: Where the case comes from: an RFC reference such as 'RFC 8037 Appendix A.4', or the literal 'generated'.

description.description: One sentence on what the case exercises.

jwks.description: Keys available to the verifier. Test keys only. Never place real key material in this directory.

token.description: The exact bytes handed to the verifier on stdin. May be malformed on purpose, so no pattern is enforced here.

alg.description: Signature algorithms known to the test suite. HS256 exists only so the RFC 7515 vector can pass and is never enabled by default.

errorCode.description: Closed error taxonomy. Adding a code requires an amendment to ADR 0003.

jwk.description: A JWK as it would appear in a JWKS. Members are validated by the verifiers, not by this schema, so invalid keys can be used as negative cases.

policy.description: Verification policy. 'iss' and 'aud' are checked only when present. 'now' is explicit so no case depends on the wall clock.

algs.description: Algorithm allowlist. The token's header never extends it.

now.description: Verification time as seconds since the Unix epoch.

typ.description: Required header 'typ'. When absent, 'typ' is not checked.

expect.description: The expected verdict. For rejections the error code must match exactly. Alternatives are not allowed.
